children.text: Weekly or bi-weekly project status meeting template focusing on milestones, risks, decisions, and action items.
Free template. Auto-fill from your meeting with Meetily - runs locally, available for Windows & macOS.

The project sync template is for recurring status meetings - typically weekly or bi-weekly - where a project lead reports on milestones, surfaces risks, and captures the decisions that move the project forward. The four tables (Milestones, Risks, Decisions, Action Items) are the bones of any status meeting; the Related Documents table closes the loop by linking the conversation back to the artifacts.

Use it for engineering project syncs, cross-functional program reviews, and any recurring meeting where you need to track the same items week-over-week. Skip it for one-off ad-hoc meetings (use the standard meeting template) or for retrospectives (use the retro template).

The standard meeting template handles one-off meetings; the project sync template handles recurring ones. The Milestones table and Related Documents table are the two structural differences. Where the standard template captures generic action items, the project sync template adds Priority and Status columns so the same task list can roll forward into the next meeting without rewriting.
What the AI summary looks like

Meetily fills the Milestones table only when an attendee explicitly reports on a milestone - it does not invent rows. The Progress Summary is one tight paragraph covering what changed since last sync. The Risks table is conservative: it captures risks that were named on the call, not inferred. The Decisions table includes a transcript timestamp so anyone can replay the moment a decision was made. Action Items propagate forward to the next meeting; closed items move to a Done status row.

children.q: Who uses this project sync template?
children.a: Engineering managers, technical program managers, and project leads running recurring weekly or bi-weekly status calls. The structure fits cross-functional projects where milestones, risks, and decisions need to be tracked from one meeting to the next.

children.q: How does Meetily auto-fill this template?
children.a: Meetily records the meeting locally on Windows or macOS, transcribes it on-device, then fills the Milestones, Risks, Decisions, Action Items, and Related Documents tables from the transcript. The Decisions table includes a timestamp column linking back to the moment in the recording where the decision was made.

children.q: How is this different from the standard meeting template?
children.a: The standard meeting template is for ad-hoc meetings with a one-off summary. The project sync template is for recurring status calls where you track the same milestones and risks week-over-week. The Milestones table and Related Documents table are the two main differences.

children.q: Can I customize the priority levels?
children.a: Yes. Copy the markdown and edit the Priority column values directly. The Meetily LLM does not enforce a fixed enum - it follows whatever convention you set in the table.

children.q: Can I download this template as Word or Google Docs?
children.a: Copy the markdown and paste it into Word, Google Docs, Confluence, or Notion. The markdown table syntax converts cleanly. There is no separate .docx file.
